detail.description: AI-native business management MCP server. 31 tools for invoicing, expenses, clients, products, quotes, tax compliance (VeriFactu), and webhooks. Multi-currency (40 currencies), OCR scanning, Stripe Connect. OAuth 2.0 + PKCE.

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: List all invoices with optional pagination. Returns a paginated list of invoices sorted by creation date. / Lista todas las facturas con paginacion opcional. Devuelve una lista paginada de facturas ordenadas por fecha de creacion.

tools.name: get_invoice
tools.description: Get a single invoice by its ID. Returns the full invoice including line items, totals, and status. / Obtiene una factura por su ID. Devuelve la factura completa con conceptos, totales y estado.

tools.name: create_invoice
tools.description: Create a new invoice. Requires client name and at least one line item. The invoice number is auto-generated. / Crea una nueva factura. Requiere nombre del cliente y al menos un concepto. El numero de factura se genera automaticamente.

tools.name: update_invoice
tools.description: Update an existing invoice. Only the provided fields will be changed. / Actualiza una factura existente. Solo se modifican los campos proporcionados.

tools.name: delete_invoice
tools.description: Permanently delete an invoice by its ID. This action cannot be undone. / Elimina permanentemente una factura por su ID. Esta accion no se puede deshacer.

tools.name: search_invoices
tools.description: Search invoices by client name. Useful for finding all invoices for a specific client. / Busca facturas por nombre de cliente. Util para encontrar todas las facturas de un cliente concreto.

tools.name: list_expenses
tools.description: List all expenses with optional pagination. / Lista todos los gastos con paginacion opcional.

tools.name: get_expense
tools.description: Get a single expense by its ID. / Obtiene un gasto por su ID.

tools.name: create_expense
tools.description: Record a new expense. Requires a description and amount. Useful for tracking business costs, deductible expenses, and vendor payments. / Registra un nuevo gasto. Requiere descripcion e importe. Util para seguimiento de costes, gastos deducibles y pagos a proveedores.

tools.name: update_expense
tools.description: Update an existing expense. Only the provided fields will be changed. / Actualiza un gasto existente. Solo se modifican los campos proporcionados.

tools.name: delete_expense
tools.description: Permanently delete an expense by its ID. This action cannot be undone. / Elimina permanentemente un gasto por su ID. Esta accion no se puede deshacer.

tools.name: list_clients
tools.description: List all clients/customers with optional pagination. Returns contact info, tax IDs, and addresses. / Lista todos los clientes con paginacion opcional. Devuelve informacion de contacto, NIF/CIF y direcciones.

tools.name: get_client
tools.description: Get a single client by their ID. Returns full contact details. / Obtiene un cliente por su ID. Devuelve todos los datos de contacto.

tools.name: create_client
tools.description: Create a new client/customer. Requires at minimum a name. Clients are used when creating invoices and quotes. / Crea un nuevo cliente. Requiere como minimo un nombre. Los clientes se usan al crear facturas y presupuestos.

tools.name: update_client
tools.description: Update an existing client. Only the provided fields will be changed. / Actualiza un cliente existente. Solo se modifican los campos proporcionados.

tools.name: delete_client
tools.description: Permanently delete a client by their ID. This action cannot be undone. Warning: this may affect existing invoices and quotes referencing this client. / Elimina permanentemente un cliente por su ID. Esta accion no se puede deshacer. Advertencia: puede afectar a facturas y presupuestos existentes.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List all products/services with optional pagination. Products are reusable items that can be added to invoices and quotes. / Lista todos los productos/servicios con paginacion opcional. Los productos son conceptos reutilizables para facturas y presupuestos.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get a single product/service by its ID. / Obtiene un producto/servicio por su ID.

tools.name: create_product
tools.description: Create a new product or service. Requires a name and unit price. Products can be referenced when creating invoices and quotes for faster data entry. / Crea un nuevo producto o servicio. Requiere nombre y precio unitario. Los productos se pueden usar al crear facturas y presupuestos.

tools.name: update_product
tools.description: Update an existing product. Only the provided fields will be changed. / Actualiza un producto existente. Solo se modifican los campos proporcionados.

tools.name: delete_product
tools.description: Permanently delete a product by its ID. This action cannot be undone. / Elimina permanentemente un producto por su ID. Esta accion no se puede deshacer.

tools.name: list_quotes
tools.description: List all quotes/estimates with optional pagination. Quotes are proposals sent to clients before they become invoices. / Lista todos los presupuestos con paginacion opcional. Los presupuestos son propuestas enviadas a clientes antes de facturar.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Get a single quote/estimate by its ID. Returns the full quote with line items and totals. / Obtiene un presupuesto por su ID. Devuelve el presupuesto completo con conceptos y totales.

tools.name: create_quote
tools.description: Create a new quote/estimate for a client. Requires client name and at least one line item. Quotes can later be converted to invoices. / Crea un nuevo presupuesto para un cliente. Requiere nombre del cliente y al menos un concepto. Los presupuestos se pueden convertir en facturas despues.

tools.name: update_quote
tools.description: Update an existing quote. Only the provided fields will be changed. / Actualiza un presupuesto existente. Solo se modifican los campos proporcionados.

tools.name: delete_quote
tools.description: Permanently delete a quote by its ID. This action cannot be undone. / Elimina permanentemente un presupuesto por su ID. Esta accion no se puede deshacer.

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: List all configured webhooks. Webhooks send HTTP POST notifications when events occur in Frihet. / Lista todos los webhooks configurados. Los webhooks envian notificaciones HTTP POST cuando ocurren eventos en Frihet.

tools.name: get_webhook
tools.description: Get a single webhook configuration by its ID. / Obtiene la configuracion de un webhook por su ID.

tools.name: create_webhook
tools.description: Register a new webhook endpoint. You must specify the URL to receive notifications and which events to subscribe to (e.g. 'invoice.created', 'invoice.paid', 'expense.created'). / Registra un nuevo endpoint de webhook. Debes especificar la URL y los eventos a los que suscribirte (ej. 'invoice.created', 'invoice.paid', 'expense.created').

tools.name: update_webhook
tools.description: Update an existing webhook configuration. Only the provided fields will be changed. / Actualiza la configuracion de un webhook. Solo se modifican los campos proporcionados.

tools.name: delete_webhook
tools.description: Permanently delete a webhook by its ID. Notifications will stop immediately. / Elimina permanentemente un webhook por su ID. Las notificaciones se detendran inmediatamente.

resources.name: api-schema
resources.description: OpenAPI schema summary: all endpoints, authentication method, rate limits, pagination, and error codes. / Resumen del esquema OpenAPI: endpoints, autenticación, límites, paginación y errores.

resources.name: tax-rates
resources.description: Current tax rates by Spanish fiscal zone: Peninsula IVA (21/10/4%), Canary Islands IGIC (7/3/0%), Ceuta IPSI, EU reverse charge, international exports, IRPF withholding, and special regimes. / Tipos impositivos por zona fiscal: IVA, IGIC, IPSI, intracomunitario, exportaciones, IRPF, regímenes especiales.

resources.name: tax-calendar
resources.description: Spanish quarterly tax calendar with filing deadlines for Modelo 303, 130, 390, 420 (IGIC), and annual returns. Includes VeriFactu e-invoicing timeline. / Calendario fiscal trimestral español con plazos de presentación de modelos y VeriFactu.

resources.name: expense-categories
resources.description: The 8 expense categories in Frihet with deductibility rules, IVA treatment, and amortization periods. Essential for correctly categorizing business expenses. / Las 8 categorías de gastos con reglas de deducibilidad, IVA y amortización.

resources.name: invoice-statuses
resources.description: Invoice status flow in Frihet: draft → sent → paid/overdue → cancelled. Includes transition rules, automation triggers, webhook events, and fiscal compliance notes. / Flujo de estados de factura: borrador → enviada → pagada/vencida → cancelada.

prompts.name: monthly-close
prompts.description: Guide through closing the month: review unpaid invoices, categorize uncategorized expenses, check tax obligations, and generate a financial summary. / Guía para el cierre mensual: revisar facturas impagadas, categorizar gastos, verificar obligaciones fiscales y generar resumen.

arguments.name: month
arguments.description: Month to close in YYYY-MM format (defaults to previous month) / Mes a cerrar

prompts.name: onboard-client
prompts.description: Set up a new client: create the client record, determine correct tax rates based on their location, and optionally create a welcome quote. / Dar de alta un nuevo cliente: crear ficha, determinar impuestos según ubicación y crear presupuesto de bienvenida.

arguments.name: clientName
arguments.description: Client or company name / Nombre del cliente o empresa

arguments.name: country
arguments.description: Client country ISO code (e.g. ES, DE, US) / Código de país

arguments.name: region
arguments.description: Spanish region if applicable (peninsula, canarias, ceuta, melilla) / Región española

prompts.name: quarterly-tax-prep
prompts.description: Prepare for quarterly tax filing: list all invoices and expenses for the quarter, calculate IVA/IGIC totals, identify deductible expenses, and generate a Modelo 303/130/420 preview. / Preparar la declaración trimestral: facturas, gastos, cálculo de IVA/IGIC, gastos deducibles y vista previa del modelo.

arguments.name: quarter
arguments.description: Quarter in format Q1-Q4 and year, e.g. 'Q1 2026' (defaults to current quarter) / Trimestre

arguments.name: fiscalZone
arguments.description: Fiscal zone for tax calculation / Zona fiscal

prompts.name: overdue-followup
prompts.description: Find all overdue invoices, draft follow-up messages for each client, and suggest payment reminders. / Buscar facturas vencidas, redactar mensajes de seguimiento y sugerir recordatorios de pago.

prompts.name: expense-batch
prompts.description: Process a batch of expenses: help categorize each one, apply correct tax rates, flag items needing receipts. / Procesar lote de gastos: categorizar, aplicar impuestos correctos, marcar los que necesitan justificante.

arguments.name: fiscalZone
arguments.description: Fiscal zone for tax deduction rules / Zona fiscal
